017package org.vafer.jdeb.maven;
018
019import static org.vafer.jdeb.maven.MissingSourceBehavior.*;
020
021import java.io.File;
022import java.io.FileNotFoundException;
023import java.io.IOException;
024import java.util.ArrayList;
025import java.util.List;
026import java.util.StringTokenizer;
027import org.apache.maven.plugins.annotations.Parameter;
028import org.vafer.jdeb.DataConsumer;
029import org.vafer.jdeb.DataProducer;
030import org.vafer.jdeb.producers.DataProducerArchive;
031import org.vafer.jdeb.producers.DataProducerDirectory;
032import org.vafer.jdeb.producers.DataProducerFile;
033import org.vafer.jdeb.producers.DataProducerFiles;
034import org.vafer.jdeb.producers.DataProducerLink;
035import org.vafer.jdeb.producers.DataProducerPathTemplate;
036
037/**
038 * Maven "data" element acting as a factory for DataProducers. So far Archive and
039 * Directory producers are supported. Both support the usual ant pattern set
040 * matching.
041 */
042public final class Data implements DataProducer {
043
044  @Parameter
045  private File src;
046
047  public void setSrc(File src) {
048    this.src = src;
049  }
050
051  @Parameter
052  private String dst;
053
054  public void setDst(String dst) {
055    this.dst = dst;
056  }
057
058  @Parameter
059  private String type;
060
061  public void setType(String type) {
062    this.type = type;
063  }
064
065  @Parameter
066  private MissingSourceBehavior missingSrc = FAIL;
067
068  public void setMissingSrc(String missingSrc) {
069    this.missingSrc = MissingSourceBehavior.valueOf(
070      missingSrc.trim().toUpperCase()
071    );
072  }
073
074  @Parameter
075  private String linkName;
076
077  public void setLinkName(String linkName) {
078    this.linkName = linkName;
079  }
080
081  @Parameter
082  private String linkTarget;
083
084  public void setLinkTarget(String linkTarget) {
085    this.linkTarget = linkTarget;
086  }
087
088  @Parameter
089  private boolean symlink = true;
090
091  public void setSymlink(boolean symlink) {
092    this.symlink = symlink;
093  }
094
095  private boolean conffile = false;
096
097  /**
098   * @parameter expression="${conffile}"
099   */
100  public void setConffile(boolean conffile) {
101    this.conffile = conffile;
102  }
103
104  public boolean getConffile() {
105    return this.conffile;
106  }
107
108  @Parameter(alias = "includes")
109  private String[] includePatterns;
110
111  public void setIncludes(String includes) {
112    includePatterns = splitPatterns(includes);
113  }
114
115  @Parameter(alias = "excludes")
116  private String[] excludePatterns;
117
118  public void setExcludes(String excludes) {
119    excludePatterns = splitPatterns(excludes);
120  }
121
122  @Parameter
123  private Mapper mapper;
124
125  @Parameter
126  private String[] paths;
127
128  /* For testing only */
129  void setPaths(String[] paths) {
130    this.paths = paths;
131  }
132
133  public String[] splitPatterns(String patterns) {
134    String[] result = null;
135    if (patterns != null && patterns.length() > 0) {
136      List<String> tokens = new ArrayList<>();
137      StringTokenizer tok = new StringTokenizer(patterns, ", ", false);
138      while (tok.hasMoreTokens()) {
139        tokens.add(tok.nextToken());
140      }
141      result = tokens.toArray(new String[tokens.size()]);
142    }
143    return result;
144  }
145
146  public void produce(final DataConsumer pReceiver) throws IOException {
147    org.vafer.jdeb.mapping.Mapper[] mappers = null;
148    if (mapper != null) {
149      mappers = new org.vafer.jdeb.mapping.Mapper[] { mapper.createMapper() };
150    }
151
152    // link type
153
154    if (typeIs("link")) {
155      if (linkName == null) {
156        throw new RuntimeException("linkName is not set");
157      }
158      if (linkTarget == null) {
159        throw new RuntimeException("linkTarget is not set");
160      }
161
162      new DataProducerLink(
163        linkName,
164        linkTarget,
165        symlink,
166        includePatterns,
167        excludePatterns,
168        mappers
169      ).produce(pReceiver);
170      return;
171    }
172
173    // template type
174
175    if (typeIs("template")) {
176      checkPaths();
177      new DataProducerPathTemplate(
178        paths,
179        includePatterns,
180        excludePatterns,
181        mappers
182      ).produce(pReceiver);
183      return;
184    }
185
186    if (typeIs("files")) {
187      checkPaths();
188      new DataProducerFiles(paths, dst, mappers).produce(pReceiver);
189      return;
190    }
191
192    // Types that require src to exist
193
194    if (src == null || !src.exists()) {
195      if (missingSrc == IGNORE) {
196        return;
197      } else {
198        throw new FileNotFoundException("Data source not found : " + src);
199      }
200    }
201
202    if (typeIs("file")) {
203      new DataProducerFile(
204        src,
205        dst,
206        includePatterns,
207        excludePatterns,
208        mappers
209      ).produce(pReceiver);
210      return;
211    }
212
213    if (typeIs("archive")) {
214      new DataProducerArchive(
215        src,
216        includePatterns,
217        excludePatterns,
218        mappers
219      ).produce(pReceiver);
220      return;
221    }
222
223    if (typeIs("directory")) {
224      new DataProducerDirectory(
225        src,
226        includePatterns,
227        excludePatterns,
228        mappers
229      ).produce(pReceiver);
230      return;
231    }
232
233    throw new IOException(
234      "Unknown type '" +
235        type +
236        "' (file|directory|archive|template|link) for " +
237        src
238    );
239  }
240
241  private boolean typeIs(final String type) {
242    return type.equalsIgnoreCase(this.type);
243  }
244
245  private void checkPaths() {
246    if (paths == null || paths.length == 0) {
247      throw new RuntimeException("paths parameter is not set");
248    }
249  }
250}
